content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway for digital products is an infrastructure solution that enables creators to sell their products without relying on traditional payment platforms. This matters because it gives creators control over their sales process, eliminates platform fees, and opens up new revenue streams. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges 0.5%, resulting in significant savings for creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway for digital products involves several components, including a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic platform like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment verification system like NOWPayments. These components work together to enable automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership for creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Crypto payment gateways for digital products eliminate platform fees and intermediaries.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a crypto payment gateway for digital products, creators can start by selecting the components that best fit their needs. They can choose a hosting platform, set up backend logic, integrate a payment verification system, and configure storage. With the right components in place, creators can start selling their digital products and receiving payments in cryptocurrency, all while maintaining control over their sales process and data.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a crypto payment gateway for digital products. This solution enables them to receive payments in cryptocurrency, such as Bitcoin or USDT, and eliminates the need for traditional payment platforms. With a crypto payment gateway, creators can reach a global audience and monetize their ebooks without relying on intermediaries.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% on every sale, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a crypto payment gateway for digital products, follow these steps: select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate a payment verification system like NOWPayments, configure storage using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and test the entire system to ensure seamless functionality. With these steps, creators can start selling their digital products and receiving payments in cryptocurrency.
